acip: DE NAS SKU'I GNAS THAMS CAD LAS 'OD ZER SNA TSOGS 'PHROS, RANG GI LUS KYI SGO THAMS CAD NAS ZHUGS SGO GSUM GYI SGRIB PA PHRA BA SBYANGS DBANG BZHI PA THOB, RDO RJE GSUM DBYER MI PHYED PA'I DNGOS GRUB THOB PAR BSAM MO,,

english: Light rays of a variety of colors fly out then from each of the places on your Lama's holy body; they sink into each of the gateways of your body and purify you of even the most subtle obstacles of body, speech, and mind--you achieve the fourth empowerment.  Imagine then that you have reached the attainment of three diamonds indivisible, one from the other.
